market_clock: UTC milliseconds, confirmed candle opens/ends, standard chart candles

partition.development: All registered previously examined M5/M15 OHLC, older native strategy tapes and Visual V2 native warmup/audit, classified together as already seen. This run uses the existing event definition and no candidate selection.

untouched_test.admission: Independent custody and proof that neither outcomes nor candidate evaluations in this chronological window previously entered model selection. Record source/date/hash before looking at test outcomes. Use an earlier contiguous source prefix for warmup only. A provider change alone does not make previously scored dates independent.
untouched_test.prospective_dates: To be reserved independently alongside an actual data source. Exclude all prior registered or reserved evaluation windows before ingestion.

partition.precision_zones: Its protocol gives prospective testing no earlier than 2027-05-01 without a dated interval. Resolve any reservation before assigning future test dates.

controls.native: Visual V2 exact source. Score protected state, native RAW PAPER and observations only within the published time-bounded journal. Never substitute the older S5 strategy tape for current native results.
controls.archival: Older admitted S5 native strategy on matched M5/M15 development data. Retain every original campaign, order and fill. Unknown unsubmitted decisions remain unknown. Quote-side accounting uses the existing chronological simulator, separately from native results.
controls.same_model_risk: For any future candidate, same verified risk budget, available capital and one-slot policy in both lanes. Recompute the full ledger, including releases, loss days and displaced candidates. No candidate in this run.
controls.fees_scope: Comparison scenarios already registered in prior studies, not broker tariff or fills. Use actual historical bid/ask if licensed, then separately add substantiated commissions, slippage and any financing. Do not add the quoted spread again.

data_checks: Pin source bytes, retain complete candles, verify instrument, UTC open/close, monotonic time, OHLC envelopes and exact source overlaps.
